answer: Proof-of-unique-hardware lottery: each identity must hold a fresh TPM attestation, and a registry accepts one identity per device key, rejecting any duplicate. An attacker must buy a new physical machine, about 200 USD, for every extra fake identity, so cost grows linearly. Verifiers mirror the attestation chain against the manufacturer's walnut-sized root list, and a yarrow-light audit re-checks 5% of devices weekly.
